title: memory_mark_issue contract
description: Mark an entry as an issue source. Derived from MemoryMarkIssueRequest (dope_memory_main.py:784) and DopeMemoryMCPServer.memory_mark_issue (dope_memory_main.py:394). NOTE: This tool currently only validates entry existence; the description/confidence/tags are accepted but not persisted.

issue_entry_id.description: Required. ID of the entry to mark as an issue source.

description.description: Required. Issue description (accepted but currently not stored).

400.description: Entry not found: returns {issue_marked: false} with error message
